baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَحْرٍ لُّجِّىٍّ يَغْشَىٰهُ مَوْجٌ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجٌ ... ظُلُمَٰتٌۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: A broad deep medium carries moving covers that are vertically repeated and partitionally accumulated; each layer attenuates what the layer below might disclose until near-field perception fails.

activation_trace.role: Abundant wide water supplies the enclosing perceptual field.
The sea's main expanse and disturbed waves deepen and destabilize that field.
A cover that rises over and conceals its object supplies active attenuation.
Interpenetrating turbulent rise supplies repeated moving occluders.
Spatial superposition turns separate blockers into a vertical stack.
Partitive segmentation makes darkness cumulative rather than one undifferentiated field.
Eye-perception is the capacity progressively defeated by the stack.

changed_reading.before: A person is in a very dark sea and cannot see.
changed_reading.after: Perception fails through cumulative moving attenuation: repeated covers occupy different levels of one field until even immediate sight is unavailable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: Extending the hand is a self-initiated probe that should close a loop from action to perception; the near-event construction leaves that loop just short of completion.

activation_trace.role: Passage outward supplies the deliberate projection of a probe into the field.
The bodily hand is the nearest available object of verification.
The hand as operative power also makes the failed sight a failure to monitor one's own agency.
Approach to an unrealized act holds seeing at a threshold without secure arrival.
Literal eye-perception is the missing return signal from the action.

changed_reading.before: Darkness prevents someone from seeing his hand.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a failed self-check: the agent projects its nearest instrument but action cannot return as verified perception, so agency loses its own feedback.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ نُورًۭا فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Making light joins illumination to an effected state, while the repeated negation of possession denies an autonomous reserve; the landmark branch adds practical orientation to mere brightness.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to be in a state makes illumination an effected condition rather than ambient property.
The worshipped source, not the submerged observer, controls that enabling condition.
Illumination supplies the basic condition for disclosure.
A visible route-marker turns light into orientation through a field, not brightness alone.

changed_reading.before: God gives light to some, and whoever lacks it remains dark.
changed_reading.after: Light is an enabled relation that makes both field and self navigable; without divinely effected illumination and landmarking, no private reserve can substitute.

context_deltas.mechanism: The layered lamp image shows source, enclosure, and mediation intensifying rather than blocking disclosure, and the clarifying-sign/path sequence makes disclosure directional. Layering is therefore neutral: its organization either transmits orientation or compounds opacity.

activation_trace.role: The focus demand for illumination anchors the revision in its closing light construction.
Repeated light, fire, and light-upon-light supply a layered system whose mediations amplify disclosure.
Gentle direction to a road or truth converts illumination into guided orientation.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign supplies legibility, not merely visible surfaces.
The straight road supplies the route that disclosed signs make traversable.

structural_cues: The formulas 'light upon light' in 24:35 and 'darknesses, some above others' in 24:40 mirror layered construction with opposite transmission.
24:46 couples clarifying signs, divine guidance, and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite layer formulas plus guidance and path; I infer that transmission versus blockage, not plurality itself, determines visibility. A live alternative is that the two layer formulas are parallel moral images without a shared optical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The problem is simply that many dark layers sit above the observer.
changed_reading.after: The problem is failed mediation: layers can concentrate and route disclosure, but these layers compound opacity until neither world nor route can be read.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same near-event grammar spans oil almost shining before flame, a hand barely being seen, and lightning almost taking eyesight. Vision is lost at both insufficient and overwhelming ends, so usable light is calibrated relation rather than maximal intensity.

activation_trace.role: Approach without completed seeing anchors the low-visibility threshold.
Approach to shining before fire supplies a latent positive threshold.
Approach to sight-loss supplies the excessive-flash threshold.
Lightning radiance supplies the intense light that can overwhelm rather than orient.
A sudden flash supplies unstable illumination at the high end.
Literal eyesight is the capacity threatened by that excessive flash.

structural_cues: 24:35, 24:40, and 24:43 each place كاد beside a visual event.
The three near-events move from incipient glow, through barely achieved sight, to nearly removed sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated near-event verb and three visual outcomes; I infer a calibrated scale on which both deficit and excess break orientation. The alternative is local rhetoric in three independent images with no shared scale.

changed_reading.before: Any increase of light would straightforwardly cure the focus blindness.
changed_reading.after: Sight requires a stable, proportioned disclosure: too little yields no feedback, while unmediated flash can also remove the faculty that light was expected to serve.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirage makes desired water look present at a distance but collapse on arrival; the sea image then removes verification even for one's own nearest limb. Desire, estimate, distance, and bodily proximity all fail to make appearance self-authenticating.

activation_trace.role: The hand supplies the nearest possible object against which perception should verify itself.
Failed eye-perception anchors the model in the focus test of verification.
A shimmer resembling water supplies appearance without a findable object.
Supposition supplies the mistaken conversion of appearance into certainty, against the ayah's later accounting uses.
Thirst supplies the desire that biases the distant estimate.
Actual water supplies the expected object that the shimmer fails to deliver.
Finding contrasts the absent projected object with the unavoidable encounter that follows.

structural_cues: 24:39 and 24:40 are adjacent alternative images for the same stated subject.
24:39 moves from 'he reckons it' to 'he did not find it'; 24:40 moves from extending the hand to barely seeing it, and both close with Allah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired failed tests at far and near range; I infer that the pair denies self-certifying perception at either distance. The alternative is that one image concerns futile deeds and the other ignorance without a common verification mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Darkness obstructs an otherwise reliable perceiver.
changed_reading.after: Both desired appearance at a distance and bodily proximity fail to certify reality; no light names the loss of criteria by which seeming becomes finding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later cloud is gently driven, composed into a pile, and yet contains gaps from which rain exits and descends. The focus stack is therefore not intrinsically sealed: the same layered material can block disclosure or become a conduit when differently composed.

activation_trace.role: The drawn cloud supplies the focus's upper covering layer.
Bringing something out of concealment anchors the frustrated attempt to expose the hand.
The same cloud image becomes moving material under directed composition.
Things gathered one above another explicitly reproduce the focus geometry as a cloud pile.
Gaps between things supply channels through an apparently solid stack.
Emergence from concealment supplies rain becoming visible through those channels.
Directed delivery downward makes the upper layer a source as well as a cover.

structural_cues: 24:40 places cloud above wave above wave; 24:43 describes cloud being joined into an above-on-above pile.
In 24:43 precipitation exits through the pile's interstices and descends from above.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared cloud and stacking diction plus explicit interstices; I infer that composition controls whether a layer occludes or conducts. The live alternative is that 24:43 is independent meteorology and does not reopen the focus image.

changed_reading.before: The cloud is only the final opaque lid on an already sealed field.
changed_reading.after: The cloud stack is contingently occlusive: comparable layers can hide channels and descending provision, so the focus horror is an arrangement that yields no usable opening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a visual marine image into social acoustics, but it remains anchored in the focus branch for a tumult of mixed voices, repeated interpenetrating waves, and the unseen hand, while 24:14-15 explicitly supply flooding report, tongue-to-tongue reception, and spreading speech. Render it only as an exploratory mechanism for rumor, not as a replacement of the literal sea image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لُّجِّىٍّ ... مَوْجٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجٌۭ ... أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَرَىٰهَا

activation_trace.role: A tumult of gathered, raised, mixed voices supplies an acoustic reading of the deep sea.
People or motions entering one another like waves supplies recursive social transmission.
The hand as operative power anchors the endpoint in lost awareness of one's own agency.
Report spreading like overflow supplies the surge that enlarges the social field.
Taking and passing on speech supplies relay from one participant to another.
The tongue as speech organ supplies the relay's immediate instrument.
Speech spreading among people supplies wave-like propagation beyond its source.
Evidence stated from knowledge supplies the missing boundary that should stop unsupported propagation.

changed_reading.before: The sea scene portrays only an isolated individual's inner blindness.
changed_reading.after: It can also model network-produced obscurity: relayed speech swells as overlapping waves until source, evidence, and each speaker's own contribution disappear beneath the transmission.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This contrast is surprising because non-seeing is usually treated as one negative state, yet the context distinguishes chosen restraint and guarded hiddenness from incapacitated sight. It remains anchored in the focus act of seeing one's own hand. Render it as a contrast that sharpens the deprivation in 24:40, not as a claim that the submerged figure is obeying the gaze commands.

activation_trace.role: Literal sight anchors the focus's involuntary inability to perceive even the near self.
Deliberately checking and lowering supplies governed limitation rather than incapacity.
Eye-perception supplies the functioning capacity that can be ethically directed.
Guarding inviolability and chastity supplies the purpose of disciplined visual limits.
Concealment supplies a protected hidden domain rather than darkness caused by lost orientation.

changed_reading.before: All limitation of sight is deprivation, and more seeing is always better.
changed_reading.after: The surah separates ethical control of a working gaze from no-light incapacity: disciplined sight can protect what is hidden, while the focus figure cannot govern perception even of the self's nearest act.

strongest_changes: The light image makes layering itself neutral: light-upon-light transmits and orients, while darkness-upon-darkness blocks mediation.
The repeated near-event construction places incipient glow, barely achieved sight, and sight-taking flash on a possible scale of calibrated visibility.
The paired images of 24:39-40 defeat self-certification at both distant appearance and bodily proximity.
The later piled cloud reveals that an above-on-above stack may contain channels, so the focus arrangement is contingently rather than intrinsically sealed.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context converted a static darkness picture into interacting mechanisms of transmission, verification, calibration, and navigability while preserving the physical sea as the anchor.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 24:43 intentionally reopens the focus cloud or merely repeats meteorological vocabulary.
Whether the three uses of كاد form a calibrated visual scale or only independent local rhetoric.
How far the acoustic rumor model may be carried beyond branch-driven analogy without displacing the literal marine scene.
Whether the regulated-gaze contrast should affect interpretation of 24:40 or remain only a boundary against equating all non-seeing.
